item.title: 290 US service members injured during Operation Epic Fury against Iran, CENTCOM says
item.summary: Around 290 U.S. service members have been injured in Operation Epic Fury, a CENTCOM spokesperson said, with more than 255 of those already returning to duty.

item.title: California governor candidate warns of 'MAGA-like' state movement unless Dems 'wake up'
item.summary: California gubernatorial candidate Matt Mahan warned that the state could see a "MAGA-like" movement if the Democratic Party failed to deliver on issues.

item.title: UK arrests 2 over 'antisemitic arson attack' as police investigate possible Iran link
item.summary: U.K. police arrested two men allegedly behind an antisemitic arson attack on Jewish ambulances in London that Prime Minister Keir Starmer called "horrifying."

item.title: American worker shot, killed in Bahamas as police launch criminal investigation: report
item.summary: Florida man Cody Castillo, 31, was fatally shot in Nassau, Bahamas, after an alleged altercation with an off-duty Royal Bahamas Police Force officer.

item.title: Iran-linked influence campaign pushes anti-Israel messaging disguised as US voices
item.summary: Foreign accounts allegedly mimic American voices online, with Argyle research claiming 60% of Operation Epic Fury discourse originates outside the U.S.

item.title: 'Superman' actress Valerie Perrine dead at 82
item.summary: Valerie Perrine, who earned an Academy Award nomination for her role in "Lenny," died on Monday in Beverly Hills following a battle with Parkinson's disease. She was 82.

item.title: Your internet router could be China-linked: FCC cracks down on ‘unacceptable’ security risks
item.summary: The FCC is moving to block new foreign-made internet routers from U.S. markets, warning that overseas supply chains pose serious national security risks.

item.title: Soros-backed DA Krasner threatens ICE agents at Philly airport: ‘I will put you in handcuffs’
item.summary: Philadelphia DA Lawrence Krasner threatens to arrest ICE agents at airports, warning Trump officials: 'I will put you in handcuffs' if laws are broken.

item.title: Biden political priorities impeded Iran negotiations, former secretary of state admits
item.summary: Former Secretary of State Antony Blinken admitted that midterm elections complicated the Biden administration's push for a stronger Iran nuclear deal.

item.title: Repeat offender with long rap sheet allegedly guns down man while free on probation, bonds despite violations
item.summary: Johnnie Lillie, 19, allegedly killed a man while free on three bonds and probation in Houston, with advocate saying the system failed to stop him.
